Land Acquisition - Mampe, kesbewa D/S Division, Colombo District
Land Acquisition - Mampe North, Kesbewa D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically detailing the acquisition of multiple plots of land for creating a water reserve and canal. It contains detailed descriptions of land parcels, their locations, claimants, and extents, with no mention of government personnel changes, structural changes, or any other specialized categories. This fits perfectly within the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land acquisition matters.
